The '''olop tree''' was a very rare [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]]. The last olop tree was destroyed on [[Bburru Station]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Duro (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attack]] on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|409|olop tree}}</ref>
